messages:
kevin_cust: Hey team — customer (BrightCart) on Dedicated is seeing lots of 429s during bursts. New replicas appear but stay Pending/ContainerCreating ~90-180s, then requests queue and we hit client-side 429s. Not seeing imagepull errors in their logs.

jessica_cs: Copying logs they sent. They say warmpool configured but not used for this surge. Repro window: 2026-03-10 14:03-14:08 UTC.

mike_support: Can you paste the pod describe and attach logs? Also any kube events around attach/heartbeat?

kevin_cust: Sure — gist: https://gist.redwood/bc-scale-attach. Key snippets:
```
Events:
  Normal Pulling  "Pulling image \"registry.internal/redwood-runtime:2026-03\""
  Normal Pulled   "Successfully pulled image"
  Warning BackOff "Back-off restarting failed container"  (but container eventually starts)
  Normal Created  "Created container attach-proxy"
  Normal Started  "Started container attach-proxy"
  Warning Unhealthy "Liveness probe failed"
```
Attach log excerpt: `attach: handshake start -> heartbeat wait 30s -> heartbeat timeout -> retry` repeated.

mike_support: Looks like probe / heartbeat timeouts during initialization. Could be noisy-tenant CPU causing long startup, or token exchange failing and delaying readiness. Did they hit any auth/billing errors?

kevin_cust: They saw a transient 403 from our registry earlier (1 retry), but policy retry masked it. Billing shows no active hold.

arjun_eng-runtime: Pinged in. Observed similar in telemetry: attach handshake sometimes blocks when kubelet cannot complete image unpack on busy nodes (high iowait). Also we've seen token rotation race where attach-proxy blocks waiting for credentials from sidecar causing readiness probe to fail and kube restart backoff.

lisa_eng-platform: Two quick asks: (1) can support collect `kubectl get pods -o wide` and `kubectl describe pod` for one stuck pod; (2) check node metrics (cpu, iowait) around timestamps. If node is saturated, scheduler will place pods but they won't become Ready fast enough and autoscaler thinks it still needs more -> hammering scale decisions.

mike_support: Repro steps requested from customer: run a short burst script (we provided) that ramps qps from 10->600 over 30s. They ran it, provided `kubectl` output attached.

kevin_cust: Posting the describe from one Pending pod:
```
Name: attach-xyz
Status: Pending -> ContainerCreating -> Running (but NotReady)
Containers:
 attach-proxy: Readiness probe failed: HTTP probe returned 500
Init Containers: none
Events:
  2m   Warning  Unhealthy  Readiness probe failed
  3m   Normal   Pulled    Image pulled
  3m   Warning  FailedAttachVolume  attach call timed out
```

arjun_eng-runtime: That `FailedAttachVolume` is interesting — could be CSI attach taking long because kubelet is saturated. Also the readiness probe returns 500 from attach-proxy because it times out waiting for registry/auth or kv cache warmup. Two failure modes at once: node pressure + sidecar auth race.

lisa_eng-platform: Short-term mitigations: raise min_replicas by 1 for that pool during business hours, and increase readiness probe timeout from 5s -> 20s for attach-proxy so transient delays don't mark NotReady. Longer-term: we should make attach-proxy startup async so readiness checks don't block on external token exchange.

mike_support: Filed a customer-facing runbook: adjust min_replicas, increase probe timeout, and enable warmpool_preferred=true for that customer. Asking eng-runtime for a patch/flag if we can soft-fail attach on auth transient.

arjun_eng-runtime: I'll open an internal ticket. Quick diagnostic command you can run (customer) to check for the token rotation race: `kubectl logs attach-xyz -c attach-proxy --since=10m | grep "token refresh"` — if you see repeated `waiting for creds` lines, that's a sign. Also check node iowait: `kubectl top node` and node exporter metrics.

kevin_cust: Customer ran the `logs|grep` and saw `waiting for creds` twice around the spike. They also saw node iowait spike to 85% on one node.

mike_support: Ok actionable plan: 1) Apply temporary config (min_replicas + probe timeout) — customer approved, will do now. 2) Platform: add a safety cap to autoscaler to avoid immediate aggressive scale up when many pods are Pending but nodes saturated (backoff window). 3) Runtime: push shortterm attach-proxy readiness change and longer-term async startup. 4) Ops: migrate some workloads off overloaded nodes or enable binpacking anti-affinity.

opsbot: runbook.update — applied label `support-mitigation:4132109876` to cluster `dedicated-bc-1`.

deploy-bot: rollout started for `support-mitigation/attach-proxy-probe` to canary (1/3).

kevin_cust: Thanks — customer confirmed immediate drop in 429s after min_replicas bump and probe change; still want eng to follow up on durable fix.

arjun_eng-runtime: Will track follow-up ticket ENG-RT-1289 and post progress here. Also adding telemetry alert for `attach-proxy readiness failures` and `node iowait > 70%` to catch earlier.

mike_support: Closing the escalation in next 48h once eng confirms fix. :thumbsup:
